backend/main.mo: Motoko backend defining access control, user profiles, blob storage integration, and rate card CRUD with permission checks.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report linking specific frontend files to verification of non-admin rate card upload flow and related components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of multiple frontend files describing their roles in the app, particularly around rate cards, quotes, and UI utilities.
frontend/docs/deployment-notes.md: Deployment verification template covering PDF export, rate card upload checks, and historical notes including known issues.
frontend/docs/pdf-export-predeploy-verif: Checklist detailing manual steps to verify PDF export behavior before deployment approval.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point loading SheetJS and jsPDF libraries from CDNs and mounting the React application.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Top-level React component setting up theme, query client, layout, and rendering MainApp with header and footer.
frontend/src/components/AccountManagerMa: UI for uploading, adding, listing, and deleting account managers with CSV parsing and React Query mutations.
frontend/src/components/AnalysisTab.tsx: Displays quote items with editable costs and computes totals and margins, allowing updates and exports.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Empty component file with no implementation.
frontend/src/components/MainApp.tsx: Defines the main tabbed app layout and routes between quote generation, analysis, history, reports, rate card, and settings.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetup.tsx: Empty component file with no implementation.
frontend/src/components/QuoteGenerator.t: Builds quotes from selected rate card items with filtering, header inputs, and backend quote/analysis generation.
Fetches and displays past quotes in a table and allows loading a selected quote for analysis.
frontend/src/components/QuoteSummary.tsx: Shows finalized quote details and supports exporting to Excel or PDF and starting a new quote.
Handles uploading and parsing rate card CSV/XLSX files, previews parsed items, and updates the backend rate card.
Displays a preview of rate card items with warnings and confirm/cancel actions before updating.
frontend/src/components/RateCardTable.ts: Renders a scrollable table listing rate card items with cost and description fields.
frontend/src/components/ReportsTab.tsx: Fetches and displays quote history with selection and Excel export functionality.
frontend/src/components/SettingsTab.tsx: Shows application settings, including account manager management.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor instance tied to Internet Identity, refreshing dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides authentication context using Internet Identity, handling login, logout, and stored identities.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Wraps backend actor calls in react-query hooks for rate cards, quotes, analysis, and account managers.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and CSS variables for color themes, including dark mode and print styles.
frontend/src/lib/accountManagerParser.ts: Parses CSV and Excel files to extract account manager names and emails, with validation for required columns.
frontend/src/lib/backendError.ts: Formats backend errors into clearer user messages, handling authorization and connectivity cases.
frontend/src/lib/excelParser.ts: Parses Excel files into structured rate‑card item data, validating required columns and converting rows to typed objects.
frontend/src/lib/formatters.ts: Provides helper functions for formatting numbers, currency, and percentages.
frontend/src/lib/pdfExporter.ts: Generates quote and analysis PDFs using jsPDF and autotable, formatting headers, tables, and totals.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration defining theme colors, animations, plugins, and container settings.
project_state.json: Project metadata including feature requests, issues, and architectural notes for the QuoteGen project.
